title: Fixed Cross-shaft Drop-target Stall
description: One newly authored complete static carnival drop-target stall: independent thick round-headed paddle targets rise from a common continuous horizontal shaft, one paddle fixed tilted back, inside a tall rear-and-side receiving hood. A separate forward barrier counter spans four grounded legs and a complete braced lower frame; an open collection shelf extends behind the counter beneath the shaft. The target field consists of separately supported solid plates rather than holes in a sloping board or pegs for rings. One whole prop zero scenes. Fixed sculptural display only: no actual rotation, impact, throwing, scoring, ball return, operation, human fit, structural load or safety claim.
